authoring.author: claude (nassaukade-506 kit lane)
authoring.note: Nassaukade 152-145, west side, the row opposite houseboat berth Nassaukade 506 (De Clercqstraat corner to the bend at 145), 1898-1900. Measured on 80 px/m rectified crops of the 2024-11-21 panoramas with a metre ruler; wall colours are medians white-balanced (to a warm white #ebe5d5; the cast is golden-hour sun) against each front's own white dressings. Two oud-west library types (three-axis 148/147/146, two-axis balcony stack 149/145); 150 (stepped gable) and the corner 151-152 have their own designs.
